title: Notification policy
help: Applies only to new events. Approval and budget alerts are critical and always bypass filtering and merging. Saving does not enable the channel or send a message.
mergedHelp: Not sent separately; inspect the original delivery outcome:
filteredHelp: Not sent because the frozen subscription threshold excluded this event.
conflict: The notification policy changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved. Reload the current policy (discarding this draft) before editing again.
digestHelp: Opt-in digest: at most 10 coding events of the same type and frozen recipient/configuration. Only event labels and resource IDs are included. The first deadline never extends; 0 disables merging. Unknown results are not resent.
unavailable: Digest is unavailable for this event/channel. Failed runs remain individual; approval and budget alerts bypass merging. Official-account templates support only exact duplicates.
